reviews.title: Hydraulic Brake Pressure Accumulator ("Bomb") Nitrogen Loss and Loss of Brake Assist
reviews.howToFix: Test the bomb by counting assisted pedal strokes with the engine off (loss of assist in under ~10 strokes indicates a depleted accumulator). Replace the pressure accumulator (P/N 893 612 061 C for pre-10/89 or 4A0 612 061 D for 1990-91), renewing the copper sealing washers/O-rings, and perform a complete Pentosin (CHF 11S) flush and refill with about 1 liter. If the fluid is old or dirty, a full bleed/refill may free a stuck valve before replacement is needed. Never substitute ATF. Inspect the hydraulic pump and servo return line for leaks at the same time.

reviews.howToFix: Replace the timing belt, tensioner(s), and water pump together as a set on the manufacturer interval (roughly every 60,000 miles) or every 5-7 years regardless of mileage.
